name: Tastry
short_description: Sensory sciences company combining analytical chemistry, consumer flavor preference data and machine learning to predict how wines will perform in market. Sells wine AI tools to wineries and retailers.

name: Analytical Flavor Systems (Gastrograph AI)
key_people: Jason Cohen (Founder, Chief Scientist), John Dori (Co-Founder)
short_description: AI company that models human sensory perception of flavor, aroma and texture to predict consumer preference for food and beverage products including beer and spirits. Acquired by NIQ in 2025.

name: Preferabli
short_description: B2B2C AI personalization and recommendation platform for wine, beer and spirits that acts as a virtual sommelier. Formerly known as Wine Ring, it added generative AI capabilities in 2023.

name: Deep Liquid
key_people: Denham D'Silva (CEO, Founder), Jamie Sherrah (CTO), Anton van den Hengel (Founder)
short_description: Adelaide company using generative AI and machine learning to design personalized beverage recipes, starting in craft beer with the award-winning Rodney AI IPA and later expanding into wellness drinks.

name: Enolytics
short_description: Data analytics platform built for wineries and spirits brands that aggregates sales channel data and applies predictive analytics and forecasting to drive direct-to-consumer growth.

name: Tule Technologies
short_description: Agtech company whose in-field sensors and Tule Vision smartphone app use AI to measure crop evapotranspiration and vine water stress from a photo, widely used in California vineyards. Acquired by CropX in 2023.

name: Deep Planet
key_people: Sushma Shankar (CEO, Co-Founder), Natalia Efremova (CTO, Co-Founder), David Carter (Co-Founder)
short_description: Founded by Oxford researchers, its VineSignal platform combines satellite imagery, ground sensors and machine learning to predict grape maturity, yield, soil moisture and disease pressure for vineyards.

name: Watgrid (WINEGRID)
short_description: Portuguese company whose WINEGRID system pairs multiparameter fermentation sensors with an IoT platform and an AI engine for real-time classification, anomaly detection and prediction during winemaking.

name: VinoVoss (BetterAI)
short_description: Silicon Valley wine search and recommendation platform by BetterAI using machine learning, generative AI, natural language processing and computer vision, with a Smart Somm chatbot trained by sommeliers.

name: Crafted ERP
short_description: Beverage ERP built on Oracle NetSuite by Doozy Solutions, offering breweries and distilleries AI-driven demand forecasting, inventory optimization and production planning across beer and spirits.

name: Aromyx
key_people: Josh Silverman (Chief Science Advisor), Brad Brown (Senior Scientist)
short_description: Stanford-founded company merging biosensors, data science and AI to quantify taste and smell, with sensory and product-recommendation applications for beer and other beverage makers.

name: BarTrack
key_people: Brett Danielson (Co-founder and CEO), Grant Hobar (Co-founder), Hunter Markle (Co-founder)
short_description: Draft beverage management company whose non-intrusive sensors and analytics platform track a dozen variables such as flow, temperature, pressure and line cleanliness to optimize draft beer quality and inventory.

name: Precision Fermentation (Sennos)
key_people: Jared Resnick (Founder and CEO), John Considine (CTO)
short_description: Maker of the BrewMonitor real-time fermentation monitoring system for breweries, using IoT sensors and adaptive analytics trained on tens of thousands of fermentations to flag events and anomalies. Rebranded to Sennos.

name: BeerBoard
short_description: On-premise alcohol management company whose Alcohol Intelligence platform captures and analyzes real-time draft and inventory data across beer, wine and spirits for bars and restaurant chains.

name: Ceres Imaging (Ceres AI)
short_description: Aerial spectral imagery and analytics platform that applies machine learning and plant science to detect water, pest, disease and fertilizer issues early, with California vineyards among its customers.

name: Sommify
short_description: Helsinki AI startup whose AI sommelier, built with the input of sommelier Julie Dupouy, gives on-trade venues and suppliers personalized wine recommendations to help sell more wine.

name: Sommelier.bot
short_description: Berlin-based AI agent for the wine and spirits industry offering a chatbot that gives consumers personalized drink recommendations.

name: Anheuser-Busch InBev
short_description: AB InBev applied machine learning (Google TensorFlow, via Pluto7) to filtration sensor data at its Newark brewery, increasing barrelage per filter run by about 60 percent while stabilizing beer taste. Its Beck's brand also released Autonomous, a beer with a recipe and branding generated by AI.

name: Kirin Holdings
short_description: Kirin built a proprietary AI recipe system, developed with Mitsubishi Research Institute, that draws on roughly 20 years of internal ingredient and tasting data to translate desired sensory profiles into ingredient combinations. Kirin plans to bring AI-supported beers to market from March 2026.

name: Sapporo Breweries
short_description: Sapporo partnered with IBM Japan to build an AI system for product development, where marketers input a concept plus up to ten flavor descriptors and a reference product from 170 past Sapporo beverages to generate new recipe candidates.

name: Heineken
key_people: Dolf van den Brink (Chairman of the Executive Board and CEO)

people.name: Dolf van den Brink
people.role: Chairman of the Executive Board and CEO

short_description: Heineken uses AI across production and supply chain, including predicting beer color in production, AI vision systems for bottle and can inspection, and machine learning demand forecasting that integrates sales, weather, events and social sentiment. Its DataPrime platform unifies data across 70-plus operating companies.

name: Molson Coors (Atwater Brewery)
short_description: Molson Coors-owned Atwater Brewery released an Artificial Intelligence IPA whose recipe was developed using ChatGPT, using Centennial, Citra, Amarillo and Hull Melon hops. The 6.9 percent ABV beer was served on draft across Atwater taprooms in Michigan.

name: PLAATO
key_people: Pal Ingebrigtsen (Co-Founder), Michael Kononsky (Co-Founder), Magnus Valmot (CEO)
short_description: PLAATO is a Norwegian manufacturing-intelligence platform for brewing and distilling whose Pro sensors feed real-time gravity and temperature data into predictive models that forecast when and at what final gravity a fermentation will end. It serves 250-plus breweries, cideries and distilleries.

name: Zymoscope
key_people: Petros Venetopoulos (Co-Founder & CEO), Mads Andersen (Co-Founder & CTO), Jens Ringsholm (Co-Founder)
short_description: Zymoscope was a Danish drinktech startup offering a non-invasive fermentation management platform combining proprietary sensors, algorithms and a mobile app for real-time remote monitoring of beer fermentation. It raised a roughly 960K euro seed round in 2021 and filed for bankruptcy in August 2024.

name: Propagate Lab
short_description: Propagate Lab, a Colorado craft-beverage yeast supplier, launched Yeast Buddy in 2024, a conversational LLM chatbot trained on its internal knowledge that guides brewers through a library of more than 120 yeast strains to select the right pitch for a target flavor and ABV.

name: Vivid Machines
key_people: Jenny Lemieux (Co-Founder & CEO), Jonathan Binas (Co-Founder & CTO)
short_description: Canadian ag-tech company whose multispectral computer-vision system mounts to farm equipment to capture per-plant data in vineyards and orchards for automated fruit counting, early yield prediction and plant-health insights.

name: VineView
key_people: Richard van der Put (CEO), Christopher MacDonald (COO)
short_description: Vineyard crop diagnostics provider using aerial and satellite imaging with AI-powered analytics to map vine vigor, detect grapevine disease and guide vineyard management, mainly in California and France. Formed in 2018 from the merger of SkySquirrel Technologies and Scientific Aerial Imaging.

name: VineForecast
key_people: Richard Petersik (Founder & CEO), Paul Petersik (Founder, R&D), Max Nowack (Founder & CTO)
short_description: German winetech startup delivering AI-based vine disease and weather forecasts that adjust for local factors such as slope, exposure and altitude, paired with a vineyard farm-management system aimed at cutting pesticide use.

name: Bloomfield Robotics
key_people: Hayden Wolf (CEO & President), Jean Rovani (Director of AI Engineering)
short_description: Carnegie Mellon spinout that combines plant-level imaging cameras with deep learning to assess vine health, count grape clusters and estimate berry color and size for vineyards. Acquired by Kubota Corporation in 2024 after strategic investments from Kubota and Oeneo.

name: Agrology
key_people: Adam Koeppel (Co-Founder & CEO), Tyler Locke (Co-Founder & CTO)
short_description: Predictive agriculture company whose in-canopy and soil sensor arrays feed machine-learning models that forecast vineyard risks up to four days ahead, including wildfire smoke taint, powdery mildew, pests and extreme weather.

name: Naio Technologies
short_description: French agricultural robotics maker whose autonomous electric Ted robot uses lidar, camera and GPS guidance to mechanically weed vineyards, with hundreds of units deployed across multiple continents.

name: Firstleaf
key_people: Philip James (Founder & CEO), Kevin Jessen (SVP Technology & Product)
short_description: Direct-to-consumer wine club operated by Penrose Hill that uses proprietary WinePrint taste-profiling technology to build individual palate profiles and recommend personalized wine selections to members.

name: DRINKS
key_people: Zac Brandenberg (Co-Founder & CEO), Barry Collier (Co-Founder & CTO/CPO)
short_description: Beverage-alcohol technology company whose AI suite (PAIR / DRINKS Recommend) powers personalized wine recommendations for online retailers, reporting large lifts in session conversions and revenue per session.

name: Outshinery
short_description: Creative-tech company producing photorealistic wine and beverage product imagery via 3D rendering, and adding generative-AI tools to help brands create marketing visuals and content at scale.

name: Next Century Spirits
key_people: Scott Bolin (Co-founder and CEO), Joel Pawlak (Co-founder), Anthony Moniello (Co-CEO), Rob Mason (Co-CEO)
short_description: Spirits technology company that uses predictive analytics, sensors and gas chromatography to model chemical profiles and control flavor outcomes during rapid barrel-alternative finishing of whiskey and other spirits.

name: Whisky Project
short_description: Community whisky blending initiative (Whisky Project Ltd) that uses a genetic-algorithm AI, robotics-driven bottling and crowdsourced sensory feedback to iteratively optimize new whisky blends.

name: Kigtek Solutions
short_description: Scottish systems-integration firm whose CaskTEK platform adds AI vision, automated quality capture and real-time analytics to whisky cask filling, disgorging and traceability to cut product loss for large distillers.

name: Whiskey Wise Group
short_description: Whiskey cask investment company that launched an AI-driven app using machine learning to analyze market trends, industry dynamics and cask values so first-time investors can make data-led decisions.

name: Overproof
short_description: Miami business-intelligence platform founded by Marc De Kuyper that delivers AI-driven sales, marketing and strategic-planning insights to beverage alcohol brands, drawing on a proprietary dataset of millions of menus and venues.

name: Winespace
key_people: Sylvain Thibaud (CEO and Co-founder), Julien Laithier (President)
short_description: Bordeaux startup whose Tastee AI tool digitizes wine tasting notes into structured, comparable taste data, developed with French research institute INRIA and able to analyze comments in 32 languages.

name: Sante
short_description: AI and fintech operating system for wine and liquor retailers combining POS, inventory, e-commerce, delivery, marketing and payments, with AI automating invoice intake, catalog creation and customer segmentation. Founded by Darren Fike (YC S23).

name: Scotch
short_description: AI-native operating system for liquor and wine retailers covering POS, payments, inventory, ordering and invoice automation plus state-by-state regulatory compliance. Raised a $10M seed in 2024 and a $20M Series A in 2026.

name: Unicorn Auctions
key_people: Phil Mikhaylov (CEO and Co-founder), A.J. Heindel (Co-founder)
short_description: Online auction platform for rare spirits and fine wine that authenticates every bottle through a proprietary system combining expert review with machine-learning algorithms trained on 500,000-plus historical transactions and 1 million-plus photos to detect inconsistencies.

name: Tastewise
short_description: GenAI food and beverage intelligence platform that ingests real-time consumer signals to guide product and marketing decisions, publishing dedicated wine, spirits and beer trend analytics for alcohol brands. Raised a $50M Series B in 2025.

name: The 5th Ingredient
short_description: Maker of Beer30 brewery-management software whose demand-planning module uses sales forecasts to predict production needs, plus a Brewery Command Center analytics platform. Serves 500-plus breweries across 20-plus countries.

name: FlavorWiki
short_description: Digital sensory and product-testing company using AI and data science to evaluate flavor, aroma, texture and mouthfeel with everyday consumers, with expertise explicitly spanning alcoholic drinks alongside food and beverages.

name: Pluto7
short_description: AI and machine learning consultancy on Google Cloud that builds supply chain and manufacturing planning solutions for producers. Delivered a machine learning model to optimize beer filtration and demand forecasting for brewer AB InBev.

name: Ohanafy
short_description: Software vendor selling an AI-powered operating system built on Salesforce to beverage suppliers, distributors, and retailers. Its AI agents automate demand forecasting, billing reconciliation, and route optimization for customers such as Sierra Nevada Brewing.

name: Enavate
short_description: Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP consulting and solutions firm with a dedicated beverage and wine practice, including the VinPoint winery platform. It implements AI tooling such as Microsoft Copilot and Power Apps to automate operations for wineries and beverage producers.

name: Overview
short_description: Vendor of AI-powered vision inspection systems (smart cameras plus the OVX platform) sold to manufacturers. Its solutions inspect beverage cans and bottles at high line speeds for defects, fill level, and seal quality.

name: Infinity Sky AI
short_description: AI automation agency and custom development studio that builds bespoke AI systems for breweries, wineries, and distilleries. Projects cover demand forecasting, inventory management, production scheduling, quality control, and TTB compliance automation.

name: Algorithm Factory
short_description: Supply chain planning software provider whose Sunstice platform is tailored to breweries and beverage manufacturers. It sells AI-based demand forecasting and production optimization to beverage makers, with reference customers including Heineken, BrewDog, and Paulaner.

name: Virtualworkforce
short_description: No-code AI agent platform sold to beverage distributors that integrates with their ERP, WMS, and POS systems. Its agents automate order capture, invoice dispute detection, inventory replenishment, and supplier engagement.

name: Haber
short_description: Industrial AI and autonomous process-optimization company that sells to process manufacturers including breweries. It applies AI to brewing water treatment, ingredient dosing, and process control to improve consistency and reduce cost.

name: RouteMagic
short_description: Vendor of AI demand forecasting and route automation software for direct-store-delivery distribution, with beverages as a named vertical. It uses an N-BEATS neural time-series model to predict 30-day demand per product and customer and to automate ordering and routing.

name: DRAMS
short_description: Spirits inventory and cask management software vendor serving whisky and other aged-spirits distilleries worldwide. Its platform adds business intelligence, wood-performance analytics, and long-term production planning on top of cask tracking.

name: GMware
short_description: Retail-intelligence software vendor whose Shield Suite sells AI demand forecasting to beverage-alcohol distributors. Its models blend depletions, POS data, weather, and event calendars to predict event-driven demand across tens of thousands of storefronts.

name: Aromalytics
short_description: Aromalytics offers an AI electronic-nose platform delivered as software and hardware as a service, digitizing smell to replace human sensory panels for food and beverage quality control and adulteration detection. It serves drinks and food manufacturers plus safety agencies.

name: FlavorActiV
short_description: FlavorActiV is a sensory-services provider selling GMP flavour standards, taster calibration, panel training, and analytical instruments including an aroma-analysing electronic nose to breweries and beverage makers. It supports professional tasting panels across beer, spirits, and other categories.

name: Alpha MOS
short_description: Alpha MOS is a publicly listed sensory-analysis solution vendor that builds electronic nose, electronic tongue, and electronic eye instruments and also runs outsourced sensory-analysis labs for food and beverage clients including beer, wine, and spirits makers. Its instruments use pattern-recognition algorithms to objectify taste and aroma.

name: Cypheme
short_description: Cypheme provides an AI computer-vision anti-counterfeit service where consumers photograph a tamper-resistant Noise Print label with a smartphone to authenticate a product in seconds. Wine and spirits brands are among the industries it protects against counterfeiting.

name: Authentic Vision
short_description: Authentic Vision sells a smartphone authentication service built on unique Holographic Fingerprint security labels that let anyone verify a bottle and detect counterfeits. Wine and spirits are core industries served, with AI-backed verification and geolocation analytics.

name: Wine Luthier
short_description: Wine Luthier is an AI service for wineries that converts a wine's physical parameters into objective flavor data and computes exact blending percentages to reach a target profile. Its tools cover flavor visualization, competitive positioning, and blend optimization for enology and production teams.

name: VerAIsonio
short_description: VerAIsonio is a data and AI consulting firm specialized in the wine industry, helping producers, merchants, and trade organisations apply AI to customer segmentation, demand forecasting, pricing, and supply-chain decisions from vineyard to market. It positions AI as support for winemaking domain expertise.

name: Brewing-AI
short_description: Brewing-AI, a solution from AlpVision SA, offers breweries a deep-reinforcement-learning system that combines operator settings with near-infrared spectroscopy and sensor data to recommend optimal fermentation parameters and hold beer quality steady across batches. It is sold as a process-optimization service to brewers.

name: IWSR
short_description: IWSR is a data, analytics, and insight service for the beverage alcohol industry, combining data science with human intelligence to model the global wine, beer, and spirits market. It sells trend forecasting and market intelligence to producers, distributors, and investors.
